verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a model lifecycle policy (release → retirement) with guidance to plan migrations before retirement, and clearly labels experimental 'Labs' models, which partially addresses deprecation concerns; API endpoints also use a v1 path convention (per /v1/models docs). However, there is no explicit documentation of API-version numbering, a formal versioning scheme change log, or an API-level deprecation/sunset timeline distinct from model lifecycle. Missing for 10: explicit API version numbering scheme, documented API deprecation/sunset timelines, and changelog for breaking API changes.
